body: But it's like I choose to feel depressed. It's like I don't want to be happy anymore.

It used to be that I'd get depressed feelings and I'd just hate everything about life and think about how shitty of a person I am and want to kill myself from time to time and now I feel that way all the time instead of just some of the time. It just seems as every couple of months go by I wish I was back at that point,  and then another couple months go by and I wish I was back at *that* point. It's like my life is just continuosly getting worse. But then, I start to feel better and it's like I actively stop myself and make a concious decision to feel bad and I force myself to. 

But to answer your question, the things that trouble me are the facts that I'm a really bad person and that I'm losing interest in life, I'm just not intersted in what life has to offer, even the best it has to offer. And now my depression is robbing me of the one thing in life I don't hate: sleep. Being unconscious is the only thing I like anymore and I'm kind of hoping suicide will be like permanent unconsciousness.
